column1: # The tools we REPLACE whose versions the base image's /foss/pdks/versions.txt
# also names. One row per tool: name, the command that prints its version, and
# the regex whose first group is the version.
# ONE table, two readers, on purpose:
#   * fork-gatekeeper/check_image_claims.py -- asks whether the shipped
#     manifest matches the shipped binary.
#   * tools/refresh_versions_manifest.sh    -- rewrites the manifest at compose
#     time so it does.
# If those two ever held separate tables, the refresher could update a tool the
# checker does not inspect (silently useless) or the checker could police a tool
# the refresher never touches (permanently red). That is the same shape as
# vibeic-eda#93 -- a check and the thing it checks drifting apart -- so the table
# is shared rather than duplicated.
# NO VERSION NUMBERS LIVE HERE. Writing one down is what created the defect this
# file fixes: the manifest said xschem 3.4.6 while the image ran 3.4.8RC,
# klayout 0.30.5 against 0.30.10, magic 8.3.589 against 8.3.678, ngspice 43
# against 46. A recorded version is a claim that goes stale on its own; a probe
# cannot.
# name
klayout
magic
ngspice
xschem
